newsitem.title: USA: SBC unit, Lucent enter alliance.
newsitem.headline: SBC unit, Lucent enter alliance.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc's Southwestern Bell said it and Lucent Technologies Inc of Murray Hill, N.J. entered an agreement valued at more than $150 million over the next five years that will involve three minority-owned companies in Missouri and Texas.
St. Louis-based World Wide Technology, a systems integrator, will provide light assembly and configuring of electronic components used by Southwestern Bell.
Harvard Manufacturing Texas, based in Austin, Texas, will do the same type of work within Southwestern Bell's Texas service territories.
The third company, TeKontrol Inc, in Arlington, Texas, will inventory and supply office products to Southwestern Bell throughout its five-state territory.

Lucent will sell materials to the minority business enterprises, which will perform light assembly and testing of the cable and components, based on Southwestern Bell's specifications. The products will then be sold to Southwestern Bell.
